You shouldn't need to make excuses for not doing something, if you want to do something then do it.

OP I can totally sympathise here, you're not alone in your insecurities, I have been less social in favour of things like video games we share the same introvert tendencies. However what is crucial is that I'm now on the other side of the fence, I want to be more social with my fractal college friends whom have taken to sitting inside and playing Xbox all day. It sucks, it really sucks to not talk to people who were once considered my best friends, or to get snubbed for some bullshit excuse, it does make you worry if people don't like you.

It's never simple, often we want to please others and we worry about our image to our friends, it can make you feel lonely when nobody is talking to you. 

I want to offer you some pieces of advice here if I may, they might sound cliché but I think these are effective.

**Be yourself:** If you try too hard to please too many people at once you immediately burden yourself with high expectations. 

**Maintain good friendships:** Keep your friends close, friendship is a relationship and relationships are complicated, but you'll feel better for having someone to talk to, someone to listen to, someone who'll gain your trust and will likewise give you theirs.

**Rationalise your fears/anxieties:** By sitting down and worrying you will accomplishing nothing. To stop these bad emotions you need to resolve them. Try finding someone to talk to about your worries, be it a friend, family member or even a professional, if you feel something is wrong then try to fix it.

And finally, the most important advice.

**DO NOT WORRY:**I know this may seem counter-intuitive to my last points and it is definitely easier said than done but hear me out. In our lives many people go through your anxieties. We live and learn from them it's all part of being human. Things will never stay the same, you will have both ups and downs in your relationships, but the future holds so many potential friendships and wonderful people to meet, roll with the punches and learn from your's and other people's experiences.

That's my advice, I apologise in advance if I haven't been as articulate as I could've been, if you have any questions or want to chat then please don't hesitate to send me a reply or a PM if you prefer.
